$comment: Prompts for tools/generate-art.mjs (Retro Diffusion). Each kind has its style, size and the approved sprites used as style references (art/references/<kind>/<id>.png). Approved sprites go to src/client/art/<kind>/<id>.png. The portraits are the starting look: plain clothes and empty hands, as characters start with nothing. portraits-evolved holds the prompts of the earlier, well-equipped portraits, kept in art/evolution/portraits/ for the look after the first class evolution. evolutions holds the portraits of the class evolutions, <evolution>-<look> (data/evolutions.json), in the frame of the portraits, the weapons kept below the top of the head so the figures scale like the others. materials holds the materials left by creatures, the parts made on the Stół rozbiórki and the treasure chest (data/materials.json). areas holds the inner regions, each a scene in a circle on the Walka screen, and lands the wide, dim backgrounds behind the cards of the lands (regions.json); both keep their background (removeBackground: false). camp holds the camp buildings, each at three looks for levels 1–3, 4–7 and 8–10 (<building>-1, -2, -3), drawn on the board and the building screens: single isometric buildings without a background, each building in its own colours, and each look a clearly bigger and richer building than the one before (a prompt may also be { prompt, style } with its own style). board holds the camp board's ground: one picture of the glade, without paths, which the game draws over it to the plots. herbs holds the herbs of Zielarstwo, professions the icons of the professions on the Profesje tab, places the backgrounds of the places where professions work (the Systemowy Zagajnik). art/spare/<kind>/<id>.png keeps sprites set aside for later: the first Błędnica (a floating pale cyan ghost flame with two faint eyes), for a future small spirit. events holds the pictures of the events at the end of an exploration (data/events.json): the people met, as full figures without a background, the foes of their fights as 48-pixel sprites like the monsters (they go to src/client/art/monsters/), and the scene behind the event (removeBackground: false on the prompt keeps its background).
